steps.title: Low-level cooking
steps.description: Cook owned shrimps, anchovies or sardines from level 1; herring unlocks at 5. Use a fire or an accessible range. The Plan checks your actual catch and budget.

steps.title: Trout, pike or salmon
steps.description: Trout unlocks at 15, pike at 20 and salmon at 25 Cooking. Use your owned fish first when practical; the Plan selects the usable recipe and its preparation.

steps.title: Tuna or owned lower-level fish
steps.description: Withdraw usable raw fish and cook at the permanent fire west of the Barbarian Village fishing spots. Cooking owned tuna does not require a fishing trip to Karamja.

steps.title: Jugs of wine
steps.description: Use grapes on jugs of water by any bank: the wine ferments by itself, no range needed. Check the current material cost and affordable batch first; failures consume ingredients and future sales are not guaranteed.

steps.title: Cooked karambwan
steps.description: Buy raw karambwan on the Grand Exchange and cook them on the Hosidius range: the fastest low-effort Cooking method.

steps.title: Pies and pizzas
steps.description: Redberry (10), meat (20) and apple pies (30), plain (35) and anchovy pizzas (55): slower, and they sell well.

steps.title: Your own lobsters and swordfish
steps.description: Cook your own catch: slower, but the food you take into combat.

steps.title: The Cooks' Guild
steps.description: Cooking 32 and a Chef's hat: free ingredients for pies and wine inside.
